name: Edmund Husserl
contribution: An Austrian and German philosopher and mathematician who established the school of phenomenology.

checks.lead: Edmund Gustav Albrecht Husserl (Austrian German: [ˈɛdmʊnd ˈhʊsɐl]; 8 April 1859 – 27 April 1938) was an Austrian and German philosopher and mathematician who established the school of phenomenology.
